in the penumbra of a focal mass lesion in the rat brain, the ipsilateral cortical Laser Doppler flowmetry values are decreased by 50% and the ipsilateral intraparenchmal tissue oxygen pressure by 80% compared to the contralateral side.
the bilateral changes of cortical LDF and intraparenymal subcortical tissue p(ti)O 2 values in the penumbra of an expanding focal mass lesion in rats are significantly correlated.

In summary, our research is concerned with
a new method for the continuous monitoring of microcirculatory changes in the penumbra of a focal mass lesion.
the development of an on-line monitoring system for the continuous assessment of microcirculatory and metabolic parameters in the brain.
the development of an implantable microsensor system for the continuous, bilateral monitoring of CBF and tissue oxygen pressure.
